title: mutgate: named mutations as contracts on a test suite
description: A dependency-free tool that turns "break the code on purpose and see whether the test notices" into a checked artefact. Each mutation is a named, exact-string change to one file of the project under test, applied in a sandbox copy, with a contract naming the tests it must turn red or the statement that it must turn nothing red. Verdicts distinguish a guard that does not fire (a decoration) from a mutation that fires beyond its contract (the tell for a convention duplicated in two places) and from an invariance that breaks; a mutation whose text is not found exactly once is reported rather than silently skipped, and a verdict is only ever issued on a run pytest itself says finished.
